events.title: Playtest starts Friday. Request access now!
events.summary: The Spooky Ride Playtest opens this Friday, 11 September.Signing up takes one click and it’s free. Hit Request Access on this page and that’s the whole process. No keys to chase, no codes to trade, no waiting list to fight over. Everyone who signs up gets in.One to four riders. One very long night in the woods. And a creature called Little Big Foot who’s either your best asset or your biggest problem, depending on how you treat him.Round up three friends before Friday. You’ll want them.

events.title: Let the ride begin. Watch the announcement trailer
events.summary: Hello from the forest!We are SolidGames, and this is the first time we can say it out loud: we are making Spooky Ride, a cozy but spooky co-op puzzle adventure for 1 to 4 players. Today it stops being a secret.So what is it?It was supposed to be a normal bike trip with your squad. The trail ran along the edge of a wild national park, nothing that four people on bikes could not handle. Then something very large stepped out in front of you, and the way back stopped making sense.Stray off the path
